termsCondition.journeyWithPeaceOfMindDescription: At Alfa Omega Tours, we are delighted to help you plan and book your dream journey. Please review the following terms and conditions carefully.
termsCondition.bookingYourTourDescription: Simply contact us with your travel preferences, and our team will help you design the perfect itinerary.
termsCondition.bookingYourTourDescription2: Once we send you your customized program and you confirm your approval, your booking will proceed upon payment of the required deposit.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursMinistryComplianceDescript: Alfa Omega Tours operates in accordance with the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism regulations.
Our Official Ministry License Number, Tax Card Number, and Commercial Registration Number are displayed in the footer of our website in full compliance with Egyptian tourism regulations.
termsCondition.personalizedItineraryDescription: After receiving your request, one of our travel specialists will contact you to discuss all details and create a tailored itinerary based on your preferences.
termsCondition.personalizedItineraryDescription2: Your tour will only be confirmed once you approve the final proposal and the deposit is received.
termsCondition.bookingPolicyDescription1: A 25% deposit of the total tour cost is required to confirm your booking.
termsCondition.bookingPolicyDescription2: During peak periods (Christmas, New Year, Easter), a 50% deposit is required.
termsCondition.bookingPolicyDescription3: The remaining balance is due two days before arrival or may be paid in cash upon arrival unless otherwise agreed in writing.
termsCondition.creditCardPaymentsDescription: For credit card payments, Alfa Omega Tours may require a signed authorization letter authorizing us to charge your card.
termsCondition.creditCardPaymentsDescription2: The signature must match the one on the cardholder's passport and the one on the credit card.
termsCondition.cancellationPolicy: Cancellation Policy (Regular Periods – Excluding Peak Dates)
termsCondition.cancellationPolicyDescription: If you cancel your trip, the following fees apply:
termsCondition.cancellationPolicyDescription2: From booking date until 61 days before arrival: 15% of total tour price
termsCondition.cancellationPolicyDescription6: Airline tickets are subject to the airline's own cancellation rules. A 5% bank processing fee will be deducted from all refunds. Cancellation terms may vary for group bookings or customized itineraries.
termsCondition.cancellationPolicyChristmasDescription1: From booking date until 61 days before arrival: 25%
termsCondition.cancellationPolicyChristmasDescription5: Airline and bank fees apply as above.
termsCondition.refundPolicyDescription1: Refunds will be processed using the same payment method used for the original transaction.
termsCondition.refundPolicyDescription3: A 5% bank processing fee applies to all refunds.
termsCondition.forceMajeureDescription: Your safety and well-being are our highest priorities.
termsCondition.forceMajeureDescription2: If a government authority or airline issues a "Do Not Travel" warning to your destination:
termsCondition.forceMajeureDescription3: You will receive a refund of the tour amount paid OR
termsCondition.forceMajeureDescription4: The amount may be converted into a future travel credit valid for use on any Alfa Omega Tours destination.
termsCondition.forceMajeureDescription5: Flight cancellation or change fees are subject to airline policies. Bank charges may apply.
termsCondition.accommodationDescription1: Prices are based on two persons sharing a room.
termsCondition.accommodationDescription2: Single rooms are available at an additional cost.
termsCondition.accommodationDescription3: Hotels are selected based on quality, reputation, and service standards.
termsCondition.domesticFlightsDescription: Prices quoted are estimated averages. Schedule or fare changes may affect final pricing.
termsCondition.internationalFlightsDescription: We can assist in securing competitive fares from your home country to your destination.
termsCondition.promotionalOffersDescription1: Are valid only during the stated promotional period.
termsCondition.promotionalOffersDescription2: Apply only to confirmed bookings within the offer dates.
termsCondition.promotionalOffersDescription4: Exclude peak travel dates unless explicitly stated.
termsCondition.promotionalOffersDescription5: Do not apply to international flight tickets unless specified.
termsCondition.responsibilityDescription: Alfa Omega Tours is not responsible for circumstances beyond our control, including:
termsCondition.responsibilityDescription6: Additional costs arising from such events are not covered.
termsCondition.specialRequestsPolicyDescription: If you have special requests (dietary needs, seating preferences, etc.), please inform us at the time of booking.
termsCondition.specialRequestsPolicyDescription2: While we will do our best to accommodate such requests, they cannot be guaranteed.
termsCondition.specialRequestsPolicyDescription3: Our standard services are not conditional upon fulfilling special requests.
termsCondition.childrenPolicyDescription: A. Tour Packages, Nile Cruises & Hotels , Under 2 years: Free of charge. Under 6 years: 25% of the adult rate. Under 12 years: 50% of the adult rate. 12 years and older: Considered adults. Policy valid for one child sharing the parents' room. If flights are included, additional child supplements may apply. Sightseeing Tours & Shore Excursions — Under 6 years: Free. Under 12 years: 50% of the adult rate. 12 years and older: Adult rate. Additional supplements may apply if flights or ferries are included.
termsCondition.useOfPhotosDescription: Alfa Omega Tours may use photos and videos taken during tours for marketing purposes on our website and social media platforms. If you prefer not to appear in promotional materials, please inform us in writing.
termsCondition.tippingDescription: Tipping is customary but not mandatory. It is a personal expression of appreciation for good service.
termsCondition.websiteGeneralTermsDescription1: A. Persons under 18 years old may not transact on this website.
termsCondition.websiteGeneralTermsDescription2: Online payments are processed through secure payment gateways. Cardholders must retain transaction records. , We accept Visa and MasterCard payments in USD, EUR, GBP, and EGP where applicable. We comply with applicable international sanctions regulations. Multiple bookings may appear as multiple charges on your statement.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtection: Alfa Omega Tours Data Protection & GDPR Compliance
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription: Alfa Omega Tours respects and protects its clients' privacy.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription2: We comply with applicable international data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of the European Union, where applicable. By submitting your personal information to Alfa Omega Tours, you acknowledge and agree that:
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription4: Personal data (such as name, email, phone number, passport details, and travel preferences) is collected solely for booking, communication, and the fulfillment of travel services.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription5: Your data is stored securely and accessed only by authorized personnel.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription6: Your data will not be sold, rented, or shared with third parties except where necessary to complete your travel arrangements (such as hotels, airlines, transport providers, or payment processors).
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription7: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, subject to legal and operational requirements.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription8: Payment transactions are processed via secure, encrypted payment gateways.
termsCondition.alfaOmegaToursDataProtectionDescription9: For data-related inquiries or deletion requests, clients may contact Alfa Omega Tours directly through the official contact details provided on our website.
termsCondition.acceptanceOfAgreementDescription: By paying a deposit or final payment, the client confirms that:
termsCondition.acceptanceOfAgreementDescription1: They have read these terms and conditions.
termsCondition.acceptanceOfAgreementDescription3: They agree to be bound by this agreement with Alfa Omega Tours.

footer.description1: Alfaomega Tours is a duly licensed Egyptian tour operator holding a Class A tourism license, authorized to provide comprehensive inbound travel services throughout Egypt. The company specializes in the planning, coordination, and management of high-quality travel programs designed to meet the standards and expectations of international travelers seeking culturally authentic, professionally organized, and seamlessly executed experiences.
footer.description2: With a strong commitment to excellence, reliability, and personalized service, we provide complete travel solutions including cultural tours, luxury packages, Nile cruises, desert adventures, transportation services, and professional multilingual tour guides.
